name: Holuhraun lava field
coordinate_note: Approximate WGS84 field point from the grainflow study near the northern flow edge. The RAVEN case represents the wider lava field.

observations.detail: RAVEN sampled two flows and identified primary basalt compositions.
RAVEN conducted a rover-only mission and a separate aircraft mission.
Mission planning used local topography to assess trafficability across lava and sand.
Field investigators documented windblown sand banked against a lava margin and observed grainflows.

limitations: Survey the specific route and obtain field access. Lava roughness varies over short distances.

name: Krafla / Leirhnjúkur lava field
coordinate_note: Existing repository sampling point for the Krafla area. The paper maps the specific lava-cave survey area separately.

observations.detail: Investigators documented the lava field as basaltic.
UAV imaging and surface models documented small volcanic vent caves in Leirhnjúkur lava.

limitations: Use study maps for actual cave entrances and obtain site-specific safety and access assessments.

name: Yungay hyperarid soil site
coordinate_note: Soil location reported in Valdivia-Silva et al. and converted from degrees, minutes and seconds. Other Yungay campaigns used different sampling points.

observations.detail: The soil study sampled the hyperarid core of the Atacama.
The original study found very low detectable organics and few culturable bacteria in some samples.

limitations: Biological detections depend on technique, microhabitat, and sampling conditions.

name: Atacama / San Pedro screening point
coordinate_note: Existing regional sample point near San Pedro de Atacama.
limitations: Life in the Atacama documents regional campaigns. Study observations are not assigned to the San Pedro coordinate.

name: University Valley weather station
coordinate_note: Published weather-station coordinate converted from decimal minutes.

observations.detail: The station study reports mean near-surface air temperature of −23.4 °C.
The study documented dry permafrost above ice-cemented ground.
Ice occurred beneath dry permafrost, with station and other valley sites showing different ice depths.

limitations: Field evidence describes an upland station and valley floor. Antarctic permitting and local slope or ice surveys are required for deployment.

name: McMurdo Dry Valleys regional point
coordinate_note: Existing region-level sample point, distinct from University Valley station.
limitations: Observations from University Valley are not assigned to this regional coordinate.

name: Haughton-Mars Project Research Station
coordinate_note: Reported research station coordinate at the northwest rim. The NASA technical report covers the wider crater and Devon Island.

observations.detail: NASA documented field work with analog rovers as part of surface exploration studies.
NASA described an impact crater setting with rocky polar desert terrain and varied landforms.

limitations: Site access is seasonal and remote. Past operations provide no guarantee of current infrastructure or permits.

name: Cinder Lake Crater Field vicinity
coordinate_note: Midpoint of the published USGS UAS DEM bounding box. The particular crater test sites are documented separately.

observations.detail: USGS documents Apollo astronauts practicing sample collection at the constructed crater field.

limitations: The crater field was constructed. Consult the georeferenced USGS UAS product for exact crater locations.

name: Ustyurt Plateau / Mangystau
coordinate_note: Existing repository sampling point. Check local geomorphology before treating the point as representative of the plateau.
limitations: Candidate for screened follow-up. Local lithology, access and test infrastructure remain unverified.

name: Betpak-Dala
coordinate_note: Existing repository sampling point in the named desert region.
limitations: Candidate for screened follow-up. Site-level geological and access evidence is pending.

name: Oyyl dune field vicinity
coordinate_note: NASA photo-center coordinate, rounded to tenths of a degree.

observations.detail: NASA imagery and interpretation describe sand dunes adjacent to a floodplain, with variable vegetation.

limitations: Imagery documents dunes across a wider floodplain. Vegetation and local wind conditions affect test design.

name: Aktau Mountains sedimentary section
coordinate_note: Study-area location reported in the Aktau sedimentology paper and converted from degrees, minutes and seconds.

observations.detail: The study mapped and sampled fine-grained Miocene floodplain and mudflat deposits in the Ili Basin.

limitations: The source is a terrestrial sedimentology study. Coordinate, access and suitability for a planetary-style test require field confirmation.

name: Black Point lava flow test area
coordinate_note: Rounded test-area coordinate printed on the NASA Desert RATS report map.

observations.detail: NASA tested two rover configurations on extended lunar surface simulations.

limitations: The cited coordinate identifies an area used in 2008. Current access and traverses require verification.

name: S P Mountain / JETT3 vicinity
coordinate_note: USGS field guide stop 4 GPS point. NASA's JETT3 traverse took place east of the cone.

observations.detail: NASA conducted Artemis field EVAs east of S P Crater with a remote support team.

limitations: Regional point for catalog display. It is not an EVA station or the JETT3 traverse location.

name: Indian Tunnel, Craters of the Moon
coordinate_note: Approximate site coordinate in the NASA lidar study.

observations.detail: NASA used terrestrial lidar to survey the tube, collapse pits and adjacent surface.

limitations: The study characterized a specific lava tube. Check current access and separate cave safety requirements.

name: Mauna Ulu volcanic field vicinity
coordinate_note: Named volcanic feature coordinate in the Hawaiʻi geographic names record. BASALT sampled multiple stations.
limitations: Study-scale point. Local alteration and access vary across the flow.

name: Ibex Dune Field vicinity
coordinate_note: Rounded dune-field location used for coarse product sampling.
limitations: Screening point represents the dune vicinity. Ambient wind, migration and sand transport are different quantities.

name: Meteor Crater vicinity
coordinate_note: Rounded minute coordinates from USGS Circular 1300. The impact-melt samples did not have individual coordinates.
limitations: The point is regional. The reported sample chemistry has no point-coordinate attribution.

name: Charyn Canyon visitor-area screening point
coordinate_note: Government guide coordinate used for screening. The published sediment section was sampled separately.
limitations: Terrestrial sediment study and regional proxy. Confirm the section location, route, access and lithology in the field.
